meta.ref: main@d379d9e plus the uncommitted working tree of 2026-10-29

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Page vignette edges and the deepest shadow ink. Never a text ground.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the inside of board cells and the CRT monitor. Ground for text, text-2, text-3, steel, action-text, gold, mint and lavender in every theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks, the cabinet and the portal inspector. Ground for text, text-2, text-3 and steel (text-3 reads 5.2:1 here in Prism).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised and hover panels, active stage tabs, the project window bar, inline code. text-3 and steel sit at 4.6:1 here in Prism, the floor; keep captions on bg or surface where you can.

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: 1px structural borders, dividers, the hard offset backplate under cards and buttons. Decorative in Prism and CRT (about 2:1 on bg); a border that carries meaning uses coral, gold or mint instead.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: section tops, table rows, definition-list rows, the monitor top and bottom bars. Always 1px solid; the site's --line shorthand is 1px solid hairline.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: The sticky navigation bar, over a 12px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: The 1px-on-3px scanline ink painted by CrtFrame over media and the monitor. Multiply blend; html[data-crt=off] hides it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, surface and surface-2 (14.5:1 on bg in Prism, 15.9:1 in Paper, 18.8:1 in CRT).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body, leads, project summaries and panel summaries on bg and surface (7.6:1 on bg in Prism; 5.4:1 on surface-2).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, footer, figure captions and cell coordinates on bg (6.5:1 in Prism) or surface (5.2:1). Raised from #8a7a66 on 2026-10-16 to pass AA; 4.6:1 on surface-2 is the limit.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Metadata and DM Mono labels: sub-headings, dates, table heads, window bars, stamps. On bg or surface (6.5:1 / 5.2:1 in Prism).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The signal. Primary button fill, telegraph cells, meaningful borders, LED dots, the glow colour. As text only in Prism and CRT (6.6:1 / 8.7:1 on bg); in Paper it is 4.9:1 on bg and 3.8:1 on surface-2, so Paper links use action-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a coral fill: the primary button, the skip link (6.6:1 Prism, 5.7:1 Paper, 8.7:1 CRT).

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Link text and the play pill. Same as coral in the dark themes; a deeper brick in Paper so links keep 7.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Link hover, italic display emphasis in the H1, hover borders, the panel tag. 9.7:1 on bg in Prism. In Paper a lighter brick than action-text (5.9:1 on bg, 5.2:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on surface-2) so hover is visible; it was #8f2d0c, identical to action-text, until 2026-10-29.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The cue. Eyebrows, dates, stat chips, the status line, active stage tabs, the focus ring (2px solid, 3px offset: 12.3:1 on bg in Prism, 6.2:1 in Paper, 13.6:1 in CRT, never below 4.8:1 on any surface).

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Large display numerals only (the 54px project number, 3.6:1 on bg in Prism: AA for text 24px+ and nothing smaller). Quote rules in the source spec.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Rare deep cool accent from the reference photographs. Decorative only: 2.8:1 on bg in Prism, 3.1:1 in CRT. Never text, never a border that means something. Same value in every theme.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Last stop of the prism band (9.0:1 on bg in Prism). Decorative; not themed, so it fails on Paper grounds (1.7:1): keep it inside PrismBand and the favicon.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Resolved and safe states: hit cells, the live status in window bars, explored portals, the stamp's pulse dot. Always paired with a word or a numeral (10.5:1 on bg in Prism, 6.2:1 in Paper).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Prism band stop and the orb-b blob (9.4:1 on bg in Prism). Decorative; not themed, fails on Paper grounds (1.6:1): PrismBand and the favicon only.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Pull quotes and margin notes in Fraunces italic on bg or surface (9.4:1 on bg in Prism, 8.0:1 in Paper).

tokens.name: prism-1
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 1 (also the miss-cell tint). Gradient use only; never text.

tokens.name: prism-2
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 2: the coral itself, so a theme that moves coral moves the band.

tokens.name: prism-3
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 3: the gold.

tokens.name: prism-4
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 4 (the Prism mint, fixed so the band never turns Paper green).

tokens.name: prism-5
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 5.

tokens.name: prism-6
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 6 (the Prism lavender, fixed).

tokens.name: prism-7
tokens.usage: Prism band stop 7.

tokens.name: cell-telegraph
tokens.usage: Fill of a board cell while its cue plays, under a coral border and the glow; the step numeral in text sits on it.

tokens.name: cell-hit
tokens.usage: Fill of a correctly recalled cell, under a mint border and a mint numeral.

tokens.name: cell-miss
tokens.usage: Fill of the cell a player got wrong; the expected cell lights as cell-telegraph beside it so the feedback is positional, not only red.

tokens.name: glow-ink
tokens.usage: The colour inside the glow shadows and ripple, for anything that must glow with a custom radius.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The dialog backdrop behind PopupCRT, over a 6px blur.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces variable, always with font-variation-settings 'SOFT' 100, 'WONK' 1 (the soft 70s serif) unless a style says otherwise. Headings transition to 'SOFT' 20, 'WONK' 0, 'opsz' 144 on hover over 450ms.

styles.name: display-h1
styles.usage: The hero H1, clamp(44px, 6.6vw, 80px) on the site, with the glow shadow. Its last phrase is an italic 400 em in peach.

styles.name: display-h2
styles.usage: Section headings, 30px under 860px, with the glow-soft shadow.

styles.name: display-h3
styles.usage: Project titles, 26px under 860px.

styles.name: display-h4
styles.usage: Timeline and experience entries (h3.entry on the site).

styles.name: display-crt-title
styles.usage: The stage-3 logo title in PopupCRT: uppercase, gold, clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 44px), 24px coral text glow.

styles.name: display-scene-title
styles.usage: Scene titles inside the monitor, clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px); focus lands here after a stage change.

styles.name: display-index
styles.usage: The outlined section index (transparent fill, 1.5px coral text-stroke), clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px).

styles.name: display-numeral
styles.usage: Project row numerals in brick, coral on hover; 36px under 900px.

styles.name: display-nav-brand
styles.usage: The nav brand; the em is italic 400 in text-2.

styles.name: display-panel-title
styles.usage: InteractivePanel titles; 20px in the portal inspector (gold).

styles.name: display-quote
styles.sample: Read the board, set up the perfect turn.
styles.usage: Pull quotes and blockquotes in lavender with 'SOFT' 60; margin notes are the same at 16px.

styles.name: display-badge
styles.usage: The step numeral inside a board cell.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: DM Sans variable 400–600. Paragraphs stay under about 80 characters (max-width 56ch for leads, 60ch in project rows).

styles.name: body-lead
styles.sample: I write the systems that make games feel like games.
styles.usage: Hero lead and section leads in text-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every weapon is a ScriptableObject asset derived from Ability.
styles.usage: Body copy in text; 16px under 860px. Paragraph gap 16px.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Tables, definition lists, timeline text, nav links.

styles.name: body-button
styles.usage: Button labels; 13px for the nav CV button.

styles.name: body-panel
styles.sample: Pushes, hazards and visible enemy intent shape the tactics board.
styles.usage: Panel summaries, diagnostic cards, timeline credits, footer.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: DM Mono 400/500 for everything that reads as a label, a readout or a field note. Uppercase styles track 0.08–0.14em.

styles.name: mono-eyebrow
styles.usage: Kickers above headings, uppercase, in gold.

styles.name: mono-subhead
styles.usage: The uppercase line under a section H2, in steel, 32px below it.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Metadata lines in steel; a b inside is gold 500. Also the terminal prompt and the board status line in gold.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, pills, stat chips, panel codes, window bars (0.1em tracking), footer links at 13px.

styles.name: mono-table-head
styles.usage: Table heads and definition-list terms, uppercase, in steel.

styles.name: mono-stamp
styles.usage: Coordinate stamps, kind tags, spec-grid terms and window-bar readouts, uppercase.

styles.name: mono-util
styles.usage: Nav utility buttons (theme, motion, menu) and stage tabs.

styles.name: mono-coord
styles.usage: Row,column coordinates in the top-left of a board cell at 70% opacity; 10px in the stage-2 preview matrix.

spacing.note: 8px base. Values below 8px (6px list gaps, 4px pill padding) are exact from the source and stay.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps between inline things: button icon gap, pill row gap, nav action gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap, card and aside padding, grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, desktop gutter, blockquote margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sub-heading to content, project row vertical padding, the gap under a section head bar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Two-column grid gap, footer padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop; hero bottom.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding (64px under 860px).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Hero top padding in the original spec; the shipped hero uses space-12.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of .wrap; the monitor is min(860px, 100%).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of .wrap; 16px under 860px.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side gutter under 860px.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: The sticky nav bar; scroll-padding-top is 88px so anchors clear it.

tokens.name: gap-row
tokens.usage: Gap between columns inside a project row and between rows.

tokens.name: pad-button-y
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; utility buttons 7px, pills 4px, stage tabs 6px.

tokens.name: pad-button-x
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; utility buttons 11px, pills 10px, stage tabs 10px.

tokens.name: pad-monitor-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside the CRT monitor; the dialog has 20px around it.

tokens.name: pad-monitor-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside the CRT monitor.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum size of every control under 680px (stage tabs, close, portal nodes); primary CTAs grow to 48px.

tokens.name: dl-term
tokens.usage: Width of the term column in a definition list.

tokens.name: cover-column
tokens.usage: The figure column of a project row on desktop.

tokens.name: r-cell
tokens.usage: Board cells in the stage-2 preview matrix; the canvas corner.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, stat chips, copy buttons, the focus-ring corner, definition-list rows.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, stage tabs, board cells, notes, timeline cards, the spec grid, code blocks.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Figures, cards, panels, project rows, the cabinet, the inspector.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: The CRT monitor and large subpage panels.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, the telemetry pill, the skip link.

shadow.note: Two families of depth: a phosphor glow for the H1, the primary button and hovers, and a hard umber offset ('boxed manual') under cards and buttons. In Paper the glow becomes a 2px ink offset and the hard offset stays.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: text-shadow on the H1; box-shadow on the primary button, active panels and telegraph cells.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: text-shadow on H2.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: Reserved amber glow for gold readouts.

tokens.name: card-depth
tokens.usage: Resting hard offset under cards, CrtFrame, notes, the spec grid and the changelog.

tokens.name: card-depth-hover
tokens.usage: Hover offset under project rows and timeline cards.

tokens.name: btn-depth
tokens.usage: Resting offset under buttons and coordinate stamps; 4px for the primary button, 1px while pressed.

tokens.name: btn-depth-hover
tokens.usage: Hover offset under buttons (6px gold under the primary).

tokens.name: monitor-depth
tokens.usage: The CRT monitor inside PopupCRT.

tokens.name: frame-inset
tokens.usage: Inner vignette of CrtFrame, stacked after card-depth.

tokens.name: cover-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered project cover (lifted 4px, scaled 1.015).

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: The fixed feTurbulence film grain over the page, soft-light blend.

tokens.name: prism-band
tokens.usage: The hero prism band; 0.35 for the small section band.

tokens.name: orb
tokens.usage: The two organic orbs in PrismBand; 0.22 when small.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons (no offset shadow, no transform).

tokens.name: coord
tokens.usage: The row,column coordinate in a board cell.

tokens.name: frame-smear
tokens.usage: The blurred prism smear at the bottom of a CrtFrame figure.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: .wrap and the footer, above the vignette.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: The sticky nav.

tokens.name: z-grain
tokens.usage: The film grain overlay; everything interactive sits below it with pointer-events none on the grain.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link while focused.

tokens.name: z-popup
tokens.usage: PopupCRT.

tokens.name: z-reticle
tokens.usage: The cursor reticle.

timing.note: Durations. Every one of them collapses to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion or html[data-motion=reduced]; sequences then step at cue-step-reduced with no fades.

tokens.name: t-fast
tokens.usage: Board cell state changes, copy-button colour.

tokens.name: t-hover
tokens.usage: Link colour, button background, scanline toggle, panel lift.

tokens.name: t-lift
tokens.usage: Figure lift and shadow, nav link colour.

tokens.name: t-flicker
tokens.usage: crt-flicker stage transition.

tokens.name: t-wipe
tokens.usage: scanline-wipe stage transition.

tokens.name: t-warp
tokens.usage: phosphor-warp stage transition.

tokens.name: t-variation
tokens.usage: Heading font-variation and letter-spacing hover; project numeral 350ms.

tokens.name: t-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveal and kinetic word rise.

tokens.name: t-ripple
tokens.usage: The phosphor click ripple (removed after 650ms at the latest).

tokens.name: stagger-reveal
tokens.usage: Delay per --reveal-delay step.

tokens.name: stagger-word
tokens.usage: Delay per --word-idx in KineticText.

tokens.name: cue-step
tokens.usage: A telegraph cue on the board, then 110ms dark before the next.

tokens.name: cue-step-reduced
tokens.usage: Cue length under reduced motion; cues then stay lit until the sequence ends.

tokens.name: cue-preview
tokens.usage: Tick of the stage-2 preview loop.

tokens.name: wave-pause
tokens.usage: Pause after a wave is cleared before the next sequence plays.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The live pulse dot; wave bars alternate at 1.1s.

tokens.name: drift
tokens.usage: Prism band drift; orbs morph at 18s and 23s, paused offscreen.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: The house curve: reveals, lifts, tilt, wipe, variation hover.

tokens.name: ease-out-quint
tokens.usage: Ripple expansion and the phosphor warp.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Colour and shadow changes.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: Looping drift, pulse and wave bars.

tokens.name: blur-prism
tokens.usage: The hero prism band; 40px for the small band.

tokens.name: blur-orb
tokens.usage: Organic orbs.

tokens.name: blur-smear
tokens.usage: The prism smear under a CrtFrame figure.

tokens.name: blur-backdrop
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop.

tokens.name: blur-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky nav backdrop.
